en.lp.faq.a1: Pavo AI generates videos and images from text. Video models are Seedance 2.0 and Wan 2.7; image models are Nano Banana 2 and Seedream 4.
en.lp.faq.a2: Generation uses purchased credits. One-time credit packs start at $9.90, with monthly and yearly subscriptions also available. The generator shows the cost for your selected model and quality.
en.lp.faq.a3: Choose Video, select Seedance 2.0 (5–15 seconds) or Wan 2.7 (5–15 seconds), enter a prompt, and choose the duration, aspect ratio and 720p or 1080p quality. Review the credit cost before generating. Duration follows the selected setting, not a length mentioned in the prompt. Processing time depends on the model and queue.
en.lp.faq.a4: When you generate while signed in to a registered account, results are saved in My Creations. Return there to preview and download them.
en.lp.faq.a5: Yes. Guests can pay and generate. Leave an email to receive a download link when the result is ready. Without an email, the result downloads on completion and remains available only on the current page; refreshing closes that access.
en.lp.faq.a6: Choose a one-time credit pack or a monthly or yearly subscription. One-time pack credits do not expire; subscription credits follow the selected billing period. Check the pricing page before purchase.
en.lp.faq.a7: If the provider reports a failed generation, the credits for that task are returned. Successful generations consume credits. Contact support if a task needs investigation.
en.lp.faq.a8: Choose Seedance 2.0 or Wan 2.7 for video, and Nano Banana 2 or Seedream 4 for images. Compare the displayed credit cost and quality options before you run a prompt.

zh.lp.faq.a1: Pavo AI 支持通过文字生成视频和图片。视频模型为 Seedance 2.0、Wan 2.7，图片模型为 Nano Banana 2、Seedream 4。
zh.lp.faq.a2: 生成需要使用已购积分。一次性积分包 $9.90 起，也提供月付和年付订阅。生成器会显示所选模型与画质对应的积分消耗。
zh.lp.faq.a3: 选择视频模式和 Seedance 2.0（5–15 秒）或 Wan 2.7（5–15 秒），输入提示词，再选择时长、画面比例和 720p 或 1080p。生成前确认积分消耗。视频时长以所选设置为准，提示词中写更长的时间不会延长视频。生成耗时取决于模型和队列。
zh.lp.faq.a4: 使用已注册账户登录后生成的结果会保存到“我的作品”，之后可以随时进入预览和下载。
zh.lp.faq.a5: 可以，访客可付款后生成。留下邮箱会在完成后收到下载链接；不留邮箱则在生成完成后下载，下载入口仅保留在当前页面，刷新后无法找回。
zh.lp.faq.a6: 可选择一次性积分包、月付或年付订阅。一次性积分包不过期，订阅积分按所选计费周期使用；购买前请查看价格页。
zh.lp.faq.a7: 上游确认生成失败后，该任务消耗的积分会退回；成功生成会消耗积分。如任务需要进一步核查，请联系客服。
zh.lp.faq.a8: 视频可选 Seedance 2.0 或 Wan 2.7，图片可选 Nano Banana 2 或 Seedream 4。提交提示词前，比较显示的积分消耗和画质选项。
